def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    r90 = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    r180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    r270 = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    return [grid[i] + r90[i] for i in range(n)] + [r270[i] + r180[i] for i in range(n)]
